campaigns.context: Large ClickFix/ClearFake wave on newly registered .beer and .sbs domains with script-themed names such as bootstrap-maxcdn.beer and capcha-cdn-js.beer. Enrichment cites 80+ domains used for fake CAPTCHA and browser verification lures. One reporter (TheM3gatr0n) flagged 190 IOCs on 2026-09-24.
campaigns.name: ClearFake/ClickFix fake CAPTCHA lures on .beer and .sbs domains

campaigns.context: Magecart web-skimming infrastructure uses domains that imitate analytics, CDN and security services, such as doubleclickpro.com, feedback-hotjar.com and captchatimestamp.com. Enrichment cites a /skimmer.js path and two backend IPs on port 8888. Two reporters flagged 52 IOCs from 2026-09-11 to 2026-09-26.
campaigns.name: Magecart skimmer infrastructure on fake analytics/CDN domains

campaigns.context: Adobe-themed phishing pages lead victims to ScreenConnect client installers, many on screenconnect.com tenant subdomains such as hl-ltd, gpcom1 and strafordhomes, plus leiber.top, keepgreentb.com and onixone.com.co. Shared paths are /Bin/ScreenConnect.ClientSetup.exe and .msi, and /doc/ and /UPDATE/ on the latter two hosts. One reporter (patialavii) flagged these IOCs from 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-06.
campaigns.name: Adobe-themed phishing delivering ScreenConnect RMM installer

campaigns.context: Attackers registered many domains following a report-[brand].com pattern, impersonating companies including Chase, Binance, Kraken, Marriott, Roblox and Gilead. Enrichment ties the campaign to ShinyHunters-style vishing that harvests Okta sessions. Three reporters flagged 38 IOCs from 2026-09-16 to 2026-09-28.
campaigns.name: ShinyHunters multi-brand vishing via report-*.com domains

campaigns.context: Android malware spreads via scrambled-letter .com domains such as oiuwaksdiw.com, poiwaldsas.com, hasoadwaznqps.com and puwaiosd.com. Shared kit paths /point/download, /nenkin/download, /transtioncash and /ana impersonate Rakuten points, Japan Pension Service, ANA and a cash benefit. Reporter masaomi346 flagged these IOCs from 2026-09-19 to 2026-10-01.
campaigns.name: Japan Android malware on random-string .com domains

campaigns.context: Malvertising and ClickFix lures send victims to fake installer pages: claude-tools.com, codex-desk.com (payload from plume-compass.com), a fake Teams download, and a fake CapCut installer dropping a ScreenConnect agent from r2.dev hosts with relay.goruf.top as C2. Also seen: Trade-Journal-Setup.msi. Five reporters flagged 35 IOCs from 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: Malvertised fake software installers delivering stealers and ScreenConnect

campaigns.context: Kimsuky (DPRK) C2 infrastructure uses random subdomains under ntinvoicepload.dynu.net alongside several IPs. CobaltStrike is attributed via tags and enrichment, and promptkernelrun.com is also linked to the cluster. Six reporters flagged 26 IOCs from 2026-09-12 to 2026-10-01.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky DPRK C2 cluster on ntinvoicepload.dynu.net

campaigns.context: Phishing pages share a /login path across two lures: Roblox lookalikes such as https-wvvw-roblox.com and www-robloxk.com, and iCloud clones such as account-icloud.hnxledu.com and account-icloud.cquup.com. The shared path is weak evidence of one operator. Four reporters flagged 25 IOCs from 2026-09-10 to 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: Roblox and iCloud lookalike phishing sharing a /login path

campaigns.context: Numbered GitHub account and repository URLs such as minercraft392 and idm643-script are tagged Kimsuky. Enrichment links them to DPRK payload staging and notes a gist possibly used as a dead-drop resolver. Five reporters flagged 20 IOCs from 2026-09-14 to 2026-10-09.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky-tagged GitHub accounts staging payloads

campaigns.context: Three look-alike root domains, okta-linksso.com, okta-signinsso.com and okta-ssolink.com, carry brand-themed subdomains such as withpersona and appsflyer. Enrichment suspects UNC6671 and says they were registered on Oct 2. Enrichment also attributes myssoauth.com to UNC6671, where hollandhart.myssoauth.com spoofs the law firm Holland & Hart with an SSO theme. Two reporters (SansLimit3, TLP_R3D) flagged these IOCs from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-08.
campaigns.name: Suspected UNC6671 Okta SSO lookalike domains

campaigns.context: Phishing emails using MEDVi medication and weight-loss branding link to stylishhomegallery.com and, in a second lure sent from lepiceriemarket.com, to ktcinvesting.com, according to enrichment, which says threat intel providers flag them as malicious. One reporter (TKemmerling) flagged these IOCs from 2026-09-21 to 2026-10-06.

campaigns.name: Empire Today flooring-branded phishing via immersionhousing.com

campaigns.name: Fast personal loan phishing via financeoakmont.com

campaigns.context: ClickFix-tagged lure domains on hyphenated .online names such as video-click.online, video-hostinger.online and video-wide.online. All were flagged on 2026-10-01 by one reporter (TheM3gatr0n) from a larger source list. 14 IOCs in this batch.

campaigns.context: An ngrok.app host serves MicrosoftUpdateServices.exe as a next stage after a malicious JS sample resembling XWorm. campaigns.context: Six health-prefixed domains such as healthprimeflow.com, healthorazone.com and healthassistcarepro.com carry spam-style phishing lures, including a fake TOTAL Drive offer, a vision-test video and a Laura Geller sale. campaigns.name: ClearChoice-themed phishing emails from norahadraivnig.com

campaigns.name: Personal loan phishing redirecting to altiora.fun
